messages:
aj_sales: Quick handoff for Sparkline Health — closing the loop after contract signature. High level: 50 seats, pilot starts next week, expecting heavy embedding use for search (batch jobs + realtime lookups), chat features for agents are low qps but need <200ms p50 wherever possible. Renewal window opens in ~8 months (finance flagged budget review).

aj_sales: Current status: signed SOW, kickoff scheduled Tue 10am PT, org id = sparkline-prod, want Private deployment but starting on Redwood Hosted for first 30d. SSO planned (Okta), data residency EU, KMS TBD.

aj_sales: Risks: finance review in 8 months (possible consolidation), dependency on KMS/HSM for on-prem approval, and embedding cost could spike if we don't enable caching.

aj_sales: Owners: @sara_cs CSM (day-to-day), @mike_eng escalation for integration/latency, @tara_support for SSO/runbook. Requested next steps below — please ack and adjust assignees.

aj_sales: Next steps (initial):
- sara_cs: run pre-kick checklist and confirm 10am kickoff attendees (ETA EOD today)
- tara_support: validate Okta SAML metadata + test user flow before kickoff (ETA Mon)
- mike_eng: prepare perf baseline & config recommendations for embedding batch jobs (recommend caching + quantization) (ETA Tue)
- aj_sales: share onboarding docs + sample dataset (done)

aj_sales: Links: onboarding playbook https://redwood.example/onboarding/sparkline (bearer: redacted), sample prompts + schema in /shared/sparkline-samples.

sara_cs: Acked. I can lead the kickoff. Will slot a 30m enablement with Sparkline PMs and ops. Adding these to my checklist: support contacts, service account creation, token rotation policy.

sara_cs: Quick Q — do they need per-route cost analytics turned on? sales said yes but want minimal retention. I'll default to 30d.

aj_sales: yes, basic token-level cost/latency with 30d retention is fine for now. Finance only wants aggregated billing view.

mike_eng: On embedding load — can you share expected batch size and frequency? Also pinging @tara_support for SSO test plan.

aj_sales: Sparkline expects nightly batches ~2M embeddings and realtime lookup ~200 qps at peak for a subset. Embedding vector size 1536.

mike_eng: Got it. I'll propose: 1) KV cache for hot vectors, 2) recommendation to use quantized model for batch-only jobs, 3) autoscale policy to avoid latency spikes during lookups. I'll put a short config diff in the repo before kickoff.

tara_support: I'll take SSO. Need Okta metadata + one test user with email at sparkline.io. If they want SCIM provisioning later we can add. I'll run the SAML test by Mon and report back.

calendar-bot: calendar-bot: Event created — Sparkline Kickoff — Tue 10:00 PT — Attendees: aj_sales, sara_cs, sparkline-pm, tara_support, mike_eng — https://calendar.example/e/abcd1234

sara_cs: For enablement, I'll schedule a separate 60m deep-dive on embeddings and cost ops the week after kickoff. Will invite engineering and ops.

aj_sales: Thanks all — one follow-up: finance asked for renewal nudges at 6 and 3 months before renewal date. Can we add automated touchpoints into CS cadence?

sara_cs: I'll add a 6/3/1 month renewal checklist to the account timeline and set automated reminders. Also will capture initial NPS/feedback at 30d.

mike_eng: One ask from my side: if Sparkline moves to Dedicated or Private after pilot, ping me so I can prep migration checklist (model artifacts, quantization config, KMS).

aj_sales: noted. I'll flag decision point in the trial metrics doc.

tara_support: Will post SSO test log here once complete.

sara_cs: Closing the loop — I'll post the updated checklist and owners by EOD and tag everyone. :white_check_mark:
